prompt: A vertical two-panel composition. The top panel is a photorealistic image of a flock of flamingos standing in a shallow salt lake at sunset, with snow-capped mountains in the background and a vibrant orange and pink sky reflected on the water surface. The bottom panel features a loose, hand-drawn illustration style on a textured off-white paper background. It depicts a single pink flamingo standing in stylized blue and pink watercolor washes, with simple sketched mountains and a small sun in the distance. Above the drawing, there is handwritten Chinese text that reads "在温柔的世界里，慢慢发光。" (In a gentle world, slowly glowing) and smaller text below it reading "一些美，刚好与心相遇。" (Some beauty just meets the heart).

promptZh: 这是一幅垂直双面板构图作品。上半部分是一张逼真的摄影图片，展示了一群火烈鸟在日落时分伫立于浅盐湖中，背景是白雪皑皑的山峰，水面倒映着充满活力的橙色和粉色天空。下半部分呈现出一种松散的手绘插画风格，背景为质感丰富的米白色纸张。画面描绘了一只粉色火烈鸟站在风格化的蓝色与粉色水彩渲染之中，远处有简笔勾勒的山峦和一轮小太阳。画作上方有手写中文文字“在温柔的世界里，慢慢发光。”，其下方还有较小的文字写着“一些美，刚好与心相遇。”
